Meeting Date:                  9/14/2021
Sponsor(s):                    Waguespack (32)
Type:                          Ordinance
Title:                         Zoning Reclassification Map No. 5-G at 1540 W North Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:       Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                          ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe C1-2,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 5-G in
the area bounded by;

      the alley north of and parallel to West North Avenue; a line 51 feet west of and parallel to
      North Bosworth Avenue; West North Avenue; and, a line 76.5 feet west of and parallel to
      North Bosworth Avenue

to those of a Bl-2, Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           Scott Wag I
                                                           Alderman, T2"'' Ward




Common Addresses:
1540 West North Avenue
